page.title: Pixel Z Codes and Beginner Guide (Roblox)
page.meta_description: Pixel Z is a fast pixel-art Roblox fighter with 40+ fighters, ELO ranks and a listed code. Learn controls, combos, tips and how to start.
page.tagline: Pick a fighter, charge your ki, transform, and finish the fight with a cinematic Ultimate.
overview: Pixel Z is a fast, pixel-art 2D fighting game on Roblox from creator That One Fighting Game. You pick a fighter and battle with chainable combos, ki charging, mid-fight transformations and cinematic Ultimate finishers. The official page lists 40+ unlockable fighters, CPU matches, online ELO ranks, global ELO and Wins leaderboards, booster packs and a built-in tutorial.

The Roblox description currently lists 15KOMG as a new code. It appears at the top of the official game page; the description does not say what the code gives you. If you're searching for Pixel Z codes, start with that official listing rather than third-party lists.

Pixel Z supports keyboard controls and says it is also playable on phone, tablet and controller. The Roblox page lists a max of 100 players, and the game is available on Roblox for PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation and VR. New players can use the tutorial, then test fighters against the CPU before climbing ELO online.

how_to_play: Open Pixel Z on Roblox and press Play.
Complete the built-in tutorial if you're new; the store description says it teaches everything.
Pick a fighter from the 40+ roster. Open booster packs to find more.
Learn the basic keys: WASD to move/jump, U/I/O for light/medium/heavy, J for special, K for Ultimate, L to guard, Space to dash.
Use H to charge ki, T to transform and E for Dragon Rush.
Practice special move inputs: hold a direction + J, or Q + J. Pause > List of Movements shows the full list.
Fight the CPU or climb online ELO, and check the global ELO and Wins leaderboards.
tips: Start with the tutorial — it's built in and the description says it teaches everything.
Use CPU matches to learn a fighter's range and special inputs before you risk ELO.
Keep the move list handy: Pause > List of Movements shows every input.
Specials are not only J — try holding a direction + J, or Q + J, to access different moves.
Charge ki with H, then look for a safe moment to transform with T.
Dash with Space to close gaps or escape pressure.
Guard with L when you expect a heavy hit.
Open booster packs to expand your roster instead of sticking to one fighter.

faq.a: Pixel Z is a Roblox 2D pixel-art fighting game where you pick a fighter, chain combos, charge ki, transform mid-fight and finish with a cinematic Ultimate.

faq.q: Are there any Pixel Z codes?
faq.a: Yes. The official Roblox description lists 15KOMG as a new code.

faq.q: What is the Pixel Z code?
faq.a: The code shown in the official Roblox description is 15KOMG. The description does not state what the code rewards.

faq.q: What platforms can I play Pixel Z on?
faq.a: Pixel Z is on Roblox, which the store page lists for PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation and VR.

faq.q: How many fighters are in Pixel Z?
faq.a: The official description lists 40+ fighters to unlock.

faq.q: Can I play Pixel Z on mobile or with a controller?
faq.a: Yes. The Roblox description says the game is also playable on phone, tablet and controller.

faq.q: How do I transform in Pixel Z?
What are the controls in Pixel Z?
faq.a: Keyboard controls: WASD move/jump, U/I/O light/medium/heavy, J special, K Ultimate, L guard, Space dash, H charge ki, E Dragon Rush, T transform, P pause.

faq.q: Is Pixel Z a DBZ game?
faq.a: The official Roblox description does not name Dragon Ball. It describes ki charging, transformations and cinematic Ultimates, and YouTube coverage calls it a Roblox DBZ-style game.

faq.q: How many players can be in a Pixel Z match?
faq.a: The Roblox page lists a maximum of 100 players.
